@@ -59,11 +59,11 @@ install_packages() {
 		$SUDO apt -y install --no-install-recommends software-properties-common
 		if [ "$ID" = "ubuntu" ] && [ "$VERION_MAJOR" -lt "18" -o "$VERSION_ID" = "18.04" ]; then
 			PACKAGES=$(echo $PACKAGES | sed -r -e 's/\<ripgrep\>//')
-			$SUDO apt -y install $PACKAGES bsdmainutils vim
+			$SUDO apt -y install $PACKAGES bsdmainutils vim apt-file
 		elif [ "$ID" = "ubuntu" ] && [ "$VERION_MAJOR" -lt "20" -o "$VERSION_ID" = "20.04" ]; then
-			$SUDO apt -y install $PACKAGES bsdmainutils vim
+			$SUDO apt -y install $PACKAGES bsdmainutils vim apt-file
 		else
-			$SUDO apt -y install $PACKAGES bsdmainutils vim exa
+			$SUDO apt -y install $PACKAGES bsdmainutils vim exa apt-file
 		fi
 		;;
